create_account.description: wants to open / sign up for a new account

delete_account.description: wants to close, remove or deactivate an account

edit_account.description: wants to change account details (name, email, profile, plan settings)

recover_password.description: forgot / wants to reset a password or regain access

registration_problems.description: reports an error or problem while trying to sign up

switch_account.description: wants to move to a different account or change account type/tier

check_cancellation_fee.description: asks whether / how much it costs to cancel (early termination fee)

contact_customer_service.description: asks how to reach customer service (hours, phone, email, chat)

contact_human_agent.description: wants to talk to a real person / live agent instead of a bot

delivery_options.description: asks which shipping methods or delivery options exist

delivery_period.description: asks when an order will arrive or how long delivery takes, including late deliveries

complaint.description: wants to file a complaint or expresses dissatisfaction with the service

review.description: wants to leave feedback, a review or a rating

check_invoice.description: wants to see / look up an existing invoice or bill

get_invoice.description: wants an invoice sent or downloaded

change_order.description: wants to modify an existing order (items, quantity, details)

place_order.description: wants to buy something / make a new order

track_order.description: wants the status or location of an existing order

check_payment_methods.description: asks which payment methods are accepted

payment_issue.description: reports a problem with a payment (declined, double charged, failed)

check_refund_policy.description: asks about the refund / money-back policy or eligibility

get_refund.description: wants to request or receive a refund

track_refund.description: asks about the status of a refund already requested

change_shipping_address.description: wants to change or correct a shipping address

set_up_shipping_address.description: wants to add / set up a new shipping address

newsletter_subscription.description: wants to subscribe to, unsubscribe from, or asks about the newsletter
